apps.localizedDescription:
InputStream Player:

A player for your own playlists of live TV, movies and series on iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, Mac and Android/Google TV. In app launchers it appears as ISPlayer.

isplayer.joplabs.app · Español.

It ships no playlists, credentials or third-party keys. It is meant for content you are entitled to access.

This repository is for distribution only: verifiable releases, documentation, sample playlists and issues.

SideStore:

On the iPhone, tap the button; or in SideStore → Sources → +: https://jopsis.github.io/InputStreamPlayer/sidestore/apps.json.

With LiveContainer, turn on “Fix file picker” in the app's settings, or importing a playlist from a file will do nothing.

What it does:

• Live TV with a guide (XMLTV), remote-control zapping and catch-up.
